blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – The Batangas City Council has exempted all establishments that construct and operate electric vehicle (EV) charging stations from paying real property taxes (RPT) and local business taxes, according to a new ordinance that it has just passed. The ordinance, titled the Electric Vehicle Charging Stations Real Property Tax and Local Business Tax Exemption Ordinance of Batangas City, “covers all existing and future EV charging stations in the city, including facilities and equipment used to supply electricity to electric vehicles and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles,” the city’s Public Information Office announced on Monday.
